description: This source file defines the class SessionedSignal, which is an immutable class supporting signal enrichment within the streaming gateway service of the Eclipse Ditto project. It manages signals with associated session headers and provides methods to retrieve the enriched signal data.

classes.name: SessionedSignal
classes.description: Immutable class that wraps a Signal with session information and supports retrieving enriched signal data.

methods.name: getJsonifiable
methods.description: Returns the signal as a Jsonifiable object with predicate support.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves the Ditto headers associated with the signal.

methods.name: retrieveExtraFields
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves additional fields for the signal, handling enrichment via a facade if provided.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the associated StreamingSession.
